origin: User (2026-10-03): 「初出の画像は場合わけして考えたいね。そうすれば異常を検知できて、AUROCがさらに上がるのではないか？」
status_at_writing: Seen so far: dev1 / dev2 (A2 candidates incl. the one-sided memory, delayed re-scoring), U1 / U4 delayed re-scoring (amendment 01), intervention re-run. No within-batch read-out and no case analysis has been computed on any data.

A5_case_analysis.kind: descriptive diagnosis (labels define the cases; no detector is built from them)

cases.R: an image of the same unknown class from an earlier batch is in the memory M (at least one view)
cases.C: not R, but an image of the same class admitted from the same batch (co-arrival)
cases.N1: neither, and it is the first image of its class
cases.N+: neither, although earlier images of the class exist (none admitted)

A5_case_analysis.outcomes: share of the OOD images per case, miss rate at the ID-95% threshold and AUROC against all ID images per case (static p, static x p_LP, zeta, memory, REPRISE, delayed re-scoring); admission rates; ceiling arithmetic (AUROC against all ID is linear in OOD subsets)
A5_case_analysis.data: U1, U4 (45 streams each), dev1 / dev2 near streams

A6_within_batch_memory.idea: the case split by observable evidence: (1) a memory member of an earlier batch is near -> frozen read-out; (2) no earlier member but another image of the same batch is admitted and near -> use it; (3) neither -> static evidence only. Case (2) is new: the frozen memory reads only earlier batches.
A6_within_batch_memory.readout: '@0': the frozen memory statistic g = d - (rho - med)/mad with rho = distance to the nearest member admitted up to and including the current batch, the image itself excluded; the calibration images are scored against the same members. Entrance (who is admitted) is unchanged. Hinge variants Mh<c>@0 as before.
A6_within_batch_memory.candidates: memory in {M (frozen), M@0, Mh4@0, Mh3@0, Mh2@0} x propagation in {lp0 (warm, frozen), lp (zero start)}: 10 candidates (frozen included)

selection_rule_dev1.objective: maximise the standalone near AUROC (dev1, 5 draws x 3 orders)
constraints: x TINS near FPR95 <= frozen x TINS
selection_rule_dev1.tie_break: within 0.03 AUROC of the best: fewest changes (memory != M, hinge, propagation != lp0), then closer to the frozen read-out
selection_rule_dev1.no_selection: AUROC gain < 0.05 or no feasible candidate other than frozen

criteria: near AUROC difference (candidate - frozen): 95% t interval lower bound > 0

evaluation_after_lock.lock: selection_lock_p7.json written after the dev2 confirmation, before any '@0' metric on U1 / U4
evaluation_after_lock.data: U1 and U4 standard streams (45 each), standalone and x TINS; miss rate per appearance bin and per case

criteria.W1: U1 standalone AUROC difference: lower bound > 0
criteria.W2: U1 standalone FPR95 difference: upper bound < 0

A6_within_batch_memory.note: The scores are still issued when the batch arrives and are never revised; only images of the current and earlier batches are used (the propagation already uses the current batch).
